questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{若随机变量}X\text{与}Y\text{不相关，即不线性相关，则}\rho(X,Y)=0\text{，但}X\text{与}Y\text{未必独立.}\\&\text{则}D(X\pm Y)=D(X)+D(Y)\,.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& \text{随机变量不相关，是说不线性相关，但可以有其他的关系.}\\& \text{故若}\,\xi,\eta \text{不相关，未必有}\,\xi,\eta \text{独立；反之，若}\,\xi,\eta \text{独立，则必定有}\,\xi,\eta \text{不相关}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: egin{aligned} ext{(1)随机变量}X,Y ext{的边缘分布律分别为} & \quad P\{X=0\}= rac{2}{3},\ P\{X=1\}= rac{1}{3},\ P\{Y=1\}= rac{1}{3},\ P\{Y=2\}= rac{2}{3}. \ ext{由于} & \quad P\{X=0\} imes P\{Y=1\}= rac{2}{9} eq P\{X=0,Y=1\}= rac{1}{3},\ ext{故}X,Y ext{不相互独立}. \ ext{(2)}&\quad XY ext{可取值}0,1,2, ext{且} & \quad P\{XY=0\}=P\{X=0,Y=1\}+P\{X=0,Y=2\}= rac{2}{3}, \ & \quad P\{XY=1\}=P\{X=1,Y=1\}=0,\ P\{XY=2\}=P\{X=1,Y=2\}= rac{1}{3}. \ & ext{故}E(XY)=0 imes rac{2}{3}+1 imes0+2 imes rac{1}{3}= rac{2}{3}\cdot ext{又} \ & \quad E(X)=0 imes rac{2}{3}+1 imes rac{1}{3}= rac{1}{3},\ E(Y)=1 imes rac{1}{3}+2 imes rac{2}{3}= rac{5}{3}. \ & ext{故} \operatorname{cov}(X,Y)=E(XY)-E(X)E(Y)= rac{1}{9},\ ext{从而} ho(X,Y) eq 0.\ \ ext{因此}X,Y ext{相关}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: egin{aligned} ext{由于} \, D(X) eq 0, D(Y) eq 0, D(X\pm Y)=D(X)+D(Y)\pm 2\mathrm{cov}(X,Y)\,, ext{所以} \ D(X+Y)=D(X-Y)\ \Leftrightarrow \ \mathrm{cov}(X,Y)=0\ \Leftrightarrow \ ho_{XY}=0\,.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: egin{aligned}& ext{由} & E(X)= rac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}\sin heta d heta=0,\;\;E(Y)= rac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}\cos heta d heta=0,\;\;E(XY)= rac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}\sin heta\cos heta d heta=0\,,\& ext{得}\operatorname{cov}(X,Y)=E(XY)-E(X)E(Y)=0.\,\& ext{又} & E(X^2)= rac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}\sin^2 heta d heta eq 0,\;\;E(Y^2)= rac{1}{2\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}\cos^2 heta d heta eq 0\,,\& ext{所以} ho(X,Y)=0\,, ext{即}\lambda ext{与}y ext{不相关}.\& ext{另由于}\lambda ext{与}y ext{满足}X^2+y^2=1\,, ext{所以}\lambda ext{与}y ext{不独立}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{array}{l} \text {因} D(X+Y)=D(X)+D(Y)+2\operatorname{cov}(X,Y),\rho(X,Y)=\frac{\operatorname{cov}(X,Y)}{\sqrt{D(X)D(Y)}}=0,\text {所以若}D(X+Y)=D(X)+D(Y),\text {则} \\ \rho(X,Y)=\frac{\operatorname{cov}(X,Y)}{\sqrt{D(X)D(Y)}}=0,\text {即}\lambda\text {与}Y\text {不相关，反之也成立．}\lambda\text {与}Y\text {不相关，}\lambda\text {与}Y\text {却未必独立．} \\ \text {反之，若}\lambda\text {与}Y\text {相互独立，则}\rho(X,Y)=0,\text {从而}\operatorname{cov}(X,Y)=0,\ D(X+Y)=D(X)+D(Y). \\ \text {故}D(X+Y)=D(X)+D(Y)\text {是}\lambda\text {与}Y\text {独立的必要条件，但不是充分条件．} \\ D(X+Y)=D(X)+D(Y)\text {是}\lambda\text {与}Y\text {不相关的充分必要条件．} \end{array}
